inline bool Boolean(uint8_t value) { Require(value <= 1, "Boolean elements must be zero or one."); return value != 0; }
inline void GridBounds(int row, int rows, int col, int cols) {
  Bounds(row, rows, false); Bounds(col, cols, false);
  const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(rows) * cols;
  const int64_t offset = static_cast<int64_t>(row) * cols;
  const int64_t begin = offset + col;
  auto safe = [](int64_t v) { return v > std::numeric_limits<int>::min() && v < std::numeric_limits<int>::max(); };
  Require(count <= std::numeric_limits<int>::max() && safe(offset) && safe(count + col)
    && safe(begin) && safe(begin + count), "Grid storage offset or dimension product overflows safe kernel arithmetic.");
}
template<class T, class U> void SameGrid(const NCollection_Array2<T>& a, const NCollection_Array2<U>& b) {
  Require(a.LowerRow() == b.LowerRow() && a.LowerCol() == b.LowerCol()
    && a.NbRows() == b.NbRows() && a.NbColumns() == b.NbColumns(), "Grid bounds do not match.");
}
template<class T> void PositiveWeights(const T& weights) {
  for (const auto& w : weights) Require(w > gp::Resolution(), "Weights must be positive.");
}
inline void SplineDirection(const NCollection_Array1<double>& knots, const NCollection_Array1<int>& mults,
  int degree, bool periodic, int poles) {
  Require(knots.Lower() == 1 && mults.Lower() == 1, "Spline definition requires one-based arrays.");
  Minimum(knots, 2); SameBounds(knots, mults); Ascending(knots, true);
  Require(degree >= 1 && degree <= 25, "Invalid spline degree.");
  int64_t sum = 0;
  for (int i = 1; i <= mults.Length(); ++i) { int m = mults.Value(i); Require(m > 0 && m <= degree + 1, "Invalid knot multiplicity."); sum += m; }
  Require(sum <= std::numeric_limits<int>::max() - degree - 1, "Knot multiplicity sum overflows.");
  if (periodic) Require(mults.First() == mults.Last() && mults.First() <= degree, "Invalid periodic endpoint multiplicity.");
  Require(BSplCLib::NbPoles(degree, periodic, mults) == poles, "Surface poles do not match multiplicities.");
}

// The pinned scalar height fitter uses chord parameters on height alone. An
// exactly constant grid yields NaN despite IsDone. Preserve that common domain
// with an exact planar surface, without changing nonconstant kernel fitting.
struct SurfaceFitOwner : GeomAPI_PointsToBSplineSurface {
  opencascade::handle<Geom_BSplineSurface> FlatSurface;
  template<class... Args> SurfaceFitOwner(const NCollection_Array2<gp_Pnt>& points, Args... args)
    : GeomAPI_PointsToBSplineSurface(points, args...) {}
  template<class... Args> SurfaceFitOwner(const NCollection_Array2<double>& points, Args... args) { Init(points, args...); }
  template<class... Args> void Init(const NCollection_Array2<gp_Pnt>& points, Args... args) {
    FlatSurface.Nullify(); GeomAPI_PointsToBSplineSurface::Init(points, args...);
  }
  template<class... Args> void Interpolate(const NCollection_Array2<gp_Pnt>& points, Args... args) {
    FlatSurface.Nullify(); GeomAPI_PointsToBSplineSurface::Interpolate(points, args...);
  }
  bool MakeFlat(const NCollection_Array2<double>& z, double x0, double dx, double y0, double dy, int degree) {
    FlatSurface.Nullify(); const double height = z.First();
    for (const auto& value : z) if (value != height) return false;
    double x1 = x0 + dx * (z.NbRows() - 1), y1 = y0 + dy * (z.NbColumns() - 1);
    Require(std::isfinite(x1) && std::isfinite(y1) && x0 != x1 && y0 != y1, "Height-field domain overflows or collapses.");
    if (x1 < x0) std::swap(x0, x1); if (y1 < y0) std::swap(y0, y1);
    NCollection_Array2<gp_Pnt> poles(1, 2, 1, 2);
    poles.SetValue(1, 1, gp_Pnt(x0, y0, height)); poles.SetValue(1, 2, gp_Pnt(x0, y1, height));
    poles.SetValue(2, 1, gp_Pnt(x1, y0, height)); poles.SetValue(2, 2, gp_Pnt(x1, y1, height));
    NCollection_Array1<double> u(1, 2), v(1, 2); u.SetValue(1, x0); u.SetValue(2, x1); v.SetValue(1, y0); v.SetValue(2, y1);
    NCollection_Array1<int> mult(1, 2); mult.Init(2);
    FlatSurface = new Geom_BSplineSurface(poles, u, v, mult, mult, 1, 1);
    FlatSurface->IncreaseDegree(degree, degree); return true;
  }
  void Init(const NCollection_Array2<double>& z, double x0, double dx, double y0, double dy,
    int minDegree, int maxDegree, GeomAbs_Shape continuity, double tolerance) {
    if (!MakeFlat(z, x0, dx, y0, dy, minDegree))
      GeomAPI_PointsToBSplineSurface::Init(z, x0, dx, y0, dy, minDegree, maxDegree, continuity, tolerance);
  }
  void Interpolate(const NCollection_Array2<double>& z, double x0, double dx, double y0, double dy) {
    if (!MakeFlat(z, x0, dx, y0, dy, 3)) GeomAPI_PointsToBSplineSurface::Interpolate(z, x0, dx, y0, dy);
  }
  bool IsDone() const { return !FlatSurface.IsNull() || GeomAPI_PointsToBSplineSurface::IsDone(); }
  const opencascade::handle<Geom_BSplineSurface>& Surface() const {
    return !FlatSurface.IsNull() ? FlatSurface : GeomAPI_PointsToBSplineSurface::Surface();
  }
};
